description.en:
G1-D is Unitree's humanoid manipulation and data-development platform. It combines a configurable robot body with tools for collecting demonstrations, processing and labeling recordings, reviewing data and managing training assets. Its mechanical layout provides additional reach through articulated arms, waist and a vertically adjustable structure.

The software workflow connects task allocation and collection progress with model training and inference. Unitree describes support for distributed training, custom models and common open-source frameworks. G1-D is therefore intended as an end-to-end research and deployment system, with its actual task capabilities determined by the chosen hardware, training data and deployed policy.
